annotations.title: Decide: tool plan for a task

description: [wallet-required, $0.010/call] Describe a job and get a call-ready plan: which tools, across this catalog and outside x402 sellers with a recently verified 402, solve it end to end, in what order, with fallbacks and input params that validate against each tool's schema. Priced by depth: quick $0.003 (one best tool), plan $0.01 (the default: steps, fallbacks, params from your task, cost and latency estimates), full $0.03 (the plan plus a compiled prompt). The fee comes back as a credit toward running the plan with POST /api/decide/execute. Free first: GET /api/find?q=<task> answers a multi-step task with a keyword plan sketch. The ranking formula has no first-party term; every tool carries firstParty. Uncovered needs are listed in gaps. Returns { decisionId, task, depth, plan, estimatedCostUsd, estimatedLatencyMs, confidence, gaps }. This hosted connector holds no wallet: pay it here over MPP, or run npx agent402-mcp with a funded wallet (AGENT_KEY) or a prepaid credits key already issued (AGENT402_CREDITS_KEY), or any x402 client.

constraints.description: maxBudgetUsd, maxLatencyMs, rails [x402|mpp], chains [CAIP-2 or namespace], excludeSellers [host], requireDeterministic

task.description: What the agent needs done (max 2000 chars)
